name: Dranzer F
description: Dranzer F: a Balance phoenix with two unique abilities and one Special.

ability.name: Flame Wing
ability.description: Every successful Attack applies Phoenix Burn. Phoenix Burn deals damage equal to 12% ATK at the end of each round. Burn lasts 2 rounds. Maximum 2 stacks.

special_move.name: Blazing Phoenix Strike
special_move.description: Base damage: 115 + 55% ATK. Immediately triggers one damage tick from every active Phoenix Burn stack. Applies 1 additional Phoenix Burn stack. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

abilities.name: Flame Wing
abilities.description: Every successful Attack applies Phoenix Burn. Phoenix Burn deals damage equal to 12% ATK at the end of each round. Burn lasts 2 rounds. Maximum 2 stacks.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance
abilities.description: Reduces incoming Special damage by 15%. Restores 2 stamina when triggered. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
